Define FP16 scRGB core pixel format

One look direction (calc_look_direction) for the drawn fog of war, the minimap fog cone, is_reasonably_in_view, the minimap pins and the bots' sight: the crosshair with the recoil, or where the body faces while the crosshair is still zero - the drawn fog pointed east then, bots ignored the recoil. Your own minimap pins take your position and aim from what you see (the predicted cosmos) - recorded from the referential one, they lagged by the ping, noticeable in the narrow cone of the edge zoom-out.

Weapons on a bot's back leave out only the obstacles (make_obstacle_free_filter, shared with the thrown knife's hitting filter): bullets and knives fly through them with the pass-through sound and particles like through a human's, they still never snag on corners.

The shop shows a firearm's limit (Firearms: 1/2) instead of its space - buying at the limit drops the cheapest carried one, so it is never red. The background of a purchase that makes room is a setting (make_room_bg, make_room_active_bg) next to the other buy menu colors. num_carryable_pieces and dropping the cheapest firearm moved to item_purchase_room.hpp, included only by the shop and the logic that buys.

A knife (or anything with a free wearable slot) held in hands needs no room in the deposit - hiding puts it on the shoulder, so picking up or buying never pushes items out for it; one free slot counts once, e.g. for two knives. The order of the weapons on the back (oldest at the bottom, drawn last on top) is computed in one place for drawing and for swapping on pickup. item_pickup::process lives in item_pickup_process.hpp, included only by the logic that picks up - the views asking what can be picked up no longer compile wielding. The OFF pickup mode's comment says a picked firearm is still drawn when hands hold none.
